title: Data contract and conformance
description:
The foundation: the data model is written once in `web/amplify/data/resource.ts`. A generator turns it into a contract (models, keys, indexes, relationships, auth, storage) and the AppSync SDL, which every backend consumes. One Gherkin corpus defines how operations must behave on every backend.

Design: `design/storage.md` §1 and §2.

## Definition of done
- `resource.ts` holds the full §1 model and passes the typecheck.
- `npm run contract` is deterministic and `npm run contract:check` passes.
- The conformance corpus in `features/data/` parses, and every step is in `features/data/STEPS.md`.
